g.text: The durable format — local-only, strict, index last
The format serves two masters only: durability and open speed · nothing speculative rides in the bytes
layout at open needs zero page reads · written LAST
the page's ink — PKDrawing archive inside a
versioned TuberNotes envelope · one file per changed page
static layer envelopes below the ink · written before
imported bytes (heic · pdf) · durable before anything
a refusal is the page's, never the
a crash in here leaves orphan files
power loss, not only process crash
withheld only by its own failure —
a refused page can never wedge it
Reading: version ≠ current → refuse by number · version = current with a key missing → refuse naming the key · no silent defaults over durable facts
Every durable type's exact key set is pinned by a test beside the format version — changing one without the other fails CI.
